# PublishRank
> PublishRank 2.20.19 is more than basic SEO for WordPress publishers: it improves Mastodon sharing reliability with safer token handling and status checks, adds a five-step mobile-friendly Mastodon screen, styles editor controls in PublishRank colors, clarifies the Sitemap Hub with copy/open address controls and a sitemap file list, and moves Private Login to its own screen with migrated settings, old-link forwarding, and an emergency disable constant. It also includes a Schema Aggregator endpoint, newsroom workflows, redirects and optional llms.txt discovery. Broader AI features are rolling out soon. llms.txt and structured data do not guarantee AI citations or inclusion in generated answers.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/): Product overview, publisher workflow and FAQ
- [Features](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/features): Mastodon verification, WP Hide Login, Schema Aggregator, llms.txt, newsroom workflows and publisher SEO
- [Enterprise](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/enterprise): Enterprise publishing operating model and rollout guidance
- [Documentation](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/documentation): Setup, configuration and error reference
- [Newsroom](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/news): Publisher SEO journal and technical field guides
- [Comparisons](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/comparisons): PublishRank vs other WordPress SEO plugins
- [Download](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/download): Latest release and install guide
- [Official WordPress.org release](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/wordpress-org-release): Plugin-directory listing, features and installation options
- [Contact](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/contact): Questions, bug reports and partnerships
